title: New trail to visit "Alleged UFO Skip Site" being built near Corona, NM

content:
Corona, NM (KKOB) – A new trail is being built on federal land in Lincoln County where people will be able to visit the area where the the famous UFO first struck the Earth and then skipped before crashing near Roswell.

The roughly 2.5-mile trail to the “Alleged UFO Skip Site” is under construction on BLM land about 20 miles southeast of Corona. The hike will allow people to visit a place where some people believe a UFO first crashed near Corona, N.M., in July 1947.

The trail does not go to the the crash site, which is on a private ranch. It instead will take hikers to what has been dubbed the “skip site.where the UFO first hit the Earth and ricocheted or skipped.
